_comment: Per-suite nouns for the placeholders in shared/assertions/*.md. One judgement rule, three artefacts: a @TableTest method in a Java class, a markdown table in a facilitation response, a parametrized test in a Python or Swift file. Only the noun changes; the rule must not. Keys are lowercase and case is derived at render time — {{rows}} renders as written, {{Rows}} capitalises, {{ROWS}} upper-cases — so one entry serves every position in a sentence. Add a key here before using it in a text: build-skills.js fails on an unknown placeholder rather than shipping a literal {{brace}} to a grader.

tabletest.name: scenario name
tabletest.empty_value_notation: `''` for a string, `[]` `{}` `[:]` for a collection

spec-by-example.name: scenario name
spec-by-example.empty_value_notation: `''` for a string, `[]` `{}` `[:]` for a collection

table-driven-testing.name: scenario id
table-driven-testing.every_table: every parametrized test in the file
